prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the basic modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have advanced basic knowledge and skills in a selected sub-area of computer science
know practical concepts and applications in the selected sub-area of computer science
are able to apply scientific working methods when solving problems independently and to communicate the solution
have acquired competencies preferably from the field of technical computer science

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: Grading is from 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance is a written exam or an individual oral exam.
